heard: A wall of galaxies stretches across the deep sky. If our home galaxy were a single pebble, this wall is a mountain. It contains thousands of galaxies, like the massive coma cluster. Astronomers Margaret Geller and John Hutter mapped this sheet in 1989. The structure is a staggering 500 million light years long. Gravity shouldn't have had enough time to build something this big. Only an invisible web of dark matter makes its scale possible. Our own Milky Way still hides the wall's true end. A hidden giant remains draped across the entire sky.
